item.title: Spring-like pattern continues this week, chance for thunderstorms for Houston this weekend
item.description: Two storm systems will bring the chance for showers and storms this week, and it's the one arriving this weekend that could pack a bigger punch.

item.title: Is Houston done with freezing temperatures this winter?
item.description: Last month, Southeast Texas experienced two separate blasts of Arctic air, one that even brought sleet and freezing rain to Houston. Now temperatures have swung in the other direction, climbing into the 80s and near record levels for early February.

item.title: Neighbors express safety concerns as vacant building on Riddlewood Lane set to be demolished
item.description: Vacant and burned down buildings on Houston's southwest side are causing safety issues for neighbors in the area.

item.title: Apartment security guard accused of breaking in, assaulting man in northwest Houston complex
item.description: A security guard hired to protect residents at a northwest Houston apartment complex is now accused of breaking into an apartment and assaulting one of the very people he was supposed to protect.

item.title: Retail operator of outdoor sportswear pioneer Eddie Bauer files for bankruptcy
item.description: The operator is blaming declining sales and a litany of other industry headwinds.

item.title: City officials name acting chief for police department in wake of Humble police chief's resignation
item.description: Humble Police Department Chief Daniel Zientek has resigned from his position effective immediately on Tuesday, according to city officials.

item.title: Lindsey Vonn addresses breaking leg in downhill crash at Winter Olympics; dad wants her to retire
item.description: Lindsey Vonn posted on social, addressing the scary crash she endured sustaining, "a complex tibia fracture" Sunday at the Winter Olympics, saying, "I have no regrets." Meanwhile, her dad said, he wants her to retire.

item.title: Federal charges filed against sisters accused of holding 12-year-old captive in Montgomery Co. home
item.description: Federal prosecutors have filed kidnapping and forced labor charges against two sisters accused of brutally abusing and imprisoning a 12-year-old girl in a rural Montgomery County home.

item.title: Prairie View officer arrested, accused of sexually harassing woman during traffic stop: Records
item.description: A former Prairie View police officer is now in custody on an official oppression charge after allegedly sexually harassing a motorist, according to court documents.

item.title: Social media 'addicting the brains of children,' plaintiff's lawyer argues in landmark trial
item.description: The world's biggest social media companies face several landmark trials this year that seek to hold them responsible for harms to children who use their platforms.
